ui.cfg_b_audit_export: Export of the log of actions
cfg.h.security.read_only_strict: Nothing is written to GitHub whatever else is set: only reading commands are started, no push, no act. Only from this computer; turning it off needs a restart.
cfg.h.security.egress_policy: default: as configured. github_only: only the API of GitHub, your GitHub Enterprise host and the hosts of the allow list. none: only this computer.
cfg.h.security.egress_allow: For github_only: more hosts (name, *.name or address), or program:NAME to let a network program start (for example program:git).
cfg.f.audit_checkpoints.enabled: Signed checkpoints of the log of actions
cfg.h.audit_checkpoints.enabled: Signs the chain with a key of this installation (config/audit_checkpoint.key, or the file of MONITOR_AUDIT_KEY_FILE): a rewritten or cut log no longer verifies.
cfg.h.retention.legal_hold: While on, nothing is removed by age or by number: events, analytics, reports, copies, record of prompts and log of actions.
cfg.f.retention.audit_days: Days of the log of actions
cfg.h.retention.audit_days: 0 = for ever. Whole rotated files older than this are removed, with a signed mark of where the chain goes on.
cfg.h.retention.reports_days: 0 = no limit by age. The newest report of each account stays.
cfg.f.retention.ai_log_days: Days of the record of prompts
cfg.h.retention.ai_log_days: 0 = no limit by age (its number of lines still applies).
cfg.h.retention.backups_days: 0 = no limit by age. The newest copy always stays.
cfg.h.audit_export.enabled: Copies each new line of the log to the destination below. A destination that is down loses nothing: the lines wait in the log.
cfg.h.audit_export.target: file (JSON lines), syslog (RFC 5424 over TCP) or http (batches by POST).
cfg.h.audit_export.path: Full path of the JSON-lines file (kind file).
cfg.h.audit_export.host: Name or address of the receiver (kind syslog).
cfg.h.audit_export.port: 6514 is the usual port of syslog over TLS.
cfg.h.audit_export.tls: Turn off only for a receiver on your own network.
cfg.h.audit_export.ca_file: Empty: the authorities of the system.
cfg.h.audit_export.url: For kind http. No user or password inside the address.
cfg.h.audit_export.token_env: NAME of an environment variable, never the secret itself.
cfg.h.audit_export.batch: How many lines go in one send.
cfg.h.audit_export.spool_mb: Past this much waiting, the doctor says system.audit_export_lag.
cfg.h.audit_export.max_mb: Past it the file is renamed with .1 and a new one starts.
cfg.h.audit_export.allow_private_targets: Needed for a receiver on your own network or this computer.
